programme.title: Mann
programme.desc: Dev and Priya meet on a cruise ship and fall head over heels in love. They decide to sort out their previous betrothals and careers, and meet six months later. However, when Priya does not keep her end of the bargain, Dev is left heartbroken.

programme.title: Hum Hain Rahi Pyar Ke
programme.desc: Rahul is heavily indebted and has to bring up his two notorious nephews and a niece. One day, the kids go to a carnival and befriend a runaway bride. Trouble ensues when they decide to help her by bringing her home and keep her out of Rahul's sight.

programme.title: Prem Geet
programme.desc: Famous poet Akash (Raj Babbar) falls in love with a dancer named Shikha (Anita Raj) during a college excursion to Shimla. His father disapproves of this and wants to get him married to another girl. Meanwhile, Shikha is diagnosed with a brain tumor and Akash hides this fact from her. Since Shikha has little time to live, Akash decides to marry her and give her all the happiness he can. He even confides in his father about her illness. But will the father agree to this marriage? What will Shikha do when she finds out the truth about her terminal illness?

programme.title: Ishqiya
programme.desc: Khalujaan and Babban, two thugs, are on the run from their boss. They seek refuge at an old friend’s house but meet Krishna, his widow, instead. Both of them fall for her, oblivious to the fact that Krishna is manipulating them for her own gain.

programme.title: Khakee
programme.desc: DCP Anant and his team are assigned to escort an alleged terrorist from Chandangarh to Mumbai. His seemingly simple mission turns into a deadly encounter of survival when a rogue ex-cop turned criminal hinders his way.

programme.title: Raja Hindustani
programme.desc: A young taxi driver and a rich city girl fall head over heels in love with each other. Defying her family, she marries him and relocates to his village. But her family weaves a web of deception to split them apart.
